title: 莫甘娜 · 花园小伞
description: 莫甘娜收拢紫黑羽翼，在花园长椅旁撑着小伞等雨停。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Morgana is an adult woman with long dark purple hair, gentle violet eyes, a modest floor-length purple dress, and large dark feathered wings folded close behind her. Small violet magical lights replace any ominous effects. Retain this champion's distinctive silhouette and recognizable accessories, softened into friendly rounded shapes with opaque clothing wherever appropriate.
art_direction.scene: She sits sideways on a low garden bench, holding a lavender umbrella above one small pot of flowers while a few rounded raindrops fall. Her folded wings and boots remain inside the frame, with a puddle reflecting pale sky. Keep the composition spacious and peaceful, with visible wax-crayon strokes, warm paper margins, and every important prop clearly separated.
art_direction.palette: lavender, plum, moss green, rain blue, warm cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
